evals.prompt: Build the decision model for this internal investment case before writing any deck copy. Facts and estimates: annual software hosting/support is expected to be AED 120,000, sourced from the current run-cost estimate. A Commercial proxy values productive vessel time at AED 12,000 per hour; Finance has not yet approved that measure. DOME data are incomplete, but two recent projects recorded 18 and 31 GNSS-affected productive hours. A technical lead estimates the wider mitigation programme recovers about 30% of GNSS-affected time; this includes antennas, procedures and software, so Holocron's share is unknown. Options are hold current state, controlled expansion, or a bounded regional pilot. Build credible low/base/high cases, show break-even and a switching value, and identify what the pilot should measure. Do not choose assumptions merely to make the pilot positive.
evals.expected_output: A decision model that uses labelled assumptions, low/base/high economics, break-even and switching-value analysis, keeps programme recovery separate from Holocron attribution, and uses the pilot to replace decision-driving assumptions.
expectations: The model uses the incomplete internal data and labelled proxies rather than waiting for perfect data.
Low, base and high cases are credible adverse, best-current and favourable cases rather than target-seeking scenarios.
The response calculates the protected hours required to cover AED 120,000 of annual incremental cost at the stated value proxy.
At least one switching value is tied to an assumption that could change the preferred option.
The 30% wider-programme recovery is not attributed wholesale to Holocron.
Pilot measures map to assumptions or risks that affect the later scale decision.
